idea.title: Self-hosted dev sandboxes with preview URLs (Docker, Go, no K8s)
idea.pain: Developers waste time setting up and maintaining isolated environments, slowing down testing and collaboration.

plan.tagline: Spin up disposable dev sandboxes with live preview URLs in seconds
plan.problem: Developers waste hours configuring environments and waiting for deployments just to test small changes
plan.solution: Run `sandbox add myapp` to create a Docker container with a live preview URL instantly, no cloud accounts or complex setups needed
plan.target_market: Indie hackers and small dev teams who need quick, isolated environments without Kubernetes or cloud complexity
mvp_features: Live preview URLs via ngrok tunnel

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: SQLite schema for sandbox tracking + add/list commands with Docker subprocess calls

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Basic sandbox status reports and ngrok URL generation

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Hardcoded demo mode, help text, and edge case handling for Docker/network failures

plan.demo_script: Run `sandbox --demo` to see 3 prebuilt sandboxes (Python web server, Go API, static site) with live preview URLs generated offline
plan.phuket_angle: Thai tourism businesses can test booking widgets or microsites locally before deploying to their main site
